cuhkAdmission.introduction: Nurturing Mathematics Teachers with a Professional Attitude The B.Ed. (Mathematics and Mathematics Education) is an interdisciplinary programme co-organized by the Faculty of Education and the Department of Mathematics of CUHK. It is a double major undergraduate programme, in which students learn solid mathematical knowledge and receive integrated teacher training in both theory and practice. Teachers in the programme are well known scholars in mathematics, mathematics education or educational studies. By means of lectures, experiential learning, and teaching practice in secondary schools, the students acquire both mathematics and teacher professional knowledge, develop transferable skills in research and practice, and are equipped to assume leadership roles in mathematics teaching. Graduates are awarded a Bachelor of Education degree with a double major in Mathematics and Mathematics Education, including a qualification equivalent to a Postgraduate Diploma in Education, and are qualified to teach in secondary schools.
cuhkAdmission.ranking: The CUHK Faculty of Education is ranked 11 th in the world and 4 th in Asia in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings (Education Studies) 2025.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: The majority of BMED graduates join the teaching profession. With experience over time, some have assumed leading roles in mathematics teaching in secondary schools. With their solid knowledge and skills developed in this programme, some graduates have pursued careers in a wide range of professions, such as academic research, science and technology, finance and banking, the civil service and publishing. The programme also lays a firm foundation for graduates who desire to pursue advanced studies in mathematics, mathematics education, or related areas. In addition to knowledge and skills, we value developing students’ attitudes and professionalism. This is perhaps what our students treasure the most about the BMED programme. More BMED students’ views can be accessed on  YouTube . If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW
cuhkAdmission.craftYourPath: Students enrolled in the BMED programme learn both mathematics and educational theories. The programme design is stimulating and rewarding; its interdisciplinary nature equips our students with both subject matter and pedagogical knowledge and skills, thereby advancing their interests and passion in the fields of mathematics and education. The BMED programme also offers courses for students to enhance their subject-specific skills, such as the teaching and learning of geometry, statistics and calculus; tasks designs in STEM education; and contemporary issues in mathematics education. These courses enable them to reflect on what it means to teach and learn mathematics in the 21st century. The students’ development in all areas of mathematics and mathematics education is significant and rigorous, enabling them to see and teach mathematics from an advanced perspective.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: This double-major programme is offered by the Faculty of Education in collaboration with the Department of Mathematics. It aims to nurture professional Mathematics teachers by providing broad-based and subject-specific knowledge and sound pedagogical skills.

Students learn solid mathematical knowledge and receive integrated teacher training in both theory and practice. The programme design is stimulating and rewarding; its interdisciplinary nature equips students with both subject matter and pedagogical knowledge and skills, advancing their interests and passion in mathematics and education.

The BMED programme also offers courses for students to enhance their subject-specific skills, such as the teaching and learning of geometry, statistics and calculus; tasks designs in STEM education; and contemporary issues in mathematics education. These courses enable students to reflect on what it means to teach and learn mathematics in the 21st century.

By means of lectures, experiential learning, and teaching practice in secondary schools, students acquire both mathematics and teacher professional knowledge, develop transferable skills in research and practice, and are equipped to assume leadership roles in mathematics teaching.

Graduates are awarded a Bachelor of Education degree with a double major in Mathematics and Mathematics Education, including a qualification equivalent to a Postgraduate Diploma in Education, and are qualified to teach in secondary schools.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: The majority of BMED graduates join the teaching profession. With experience over time, some have assumed leading roles in mathematics teaching in secondary schools.

With their solid knowledge and skills developed in this programme, some graduates have pursued careers in a wide range of professions, such as academic research, science and technology, finance and banking, the civil service and publishing.
The programme also lays a firm foundation for graduates who desire to pursue advanced studies in mathematics, mathematics education, or related areas.
In addition to knowledge and skills, the programme values developing students’ attitudes and professionalism. More BMED students’ views can be accessed on YouTube.

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK’s Shatin campus offers a vibrant and supportive learning environment with nine colleges, each providing unique residential, pastoral, and cultural experiences.
Students benefit from state-of-the-art facilities, libraries, and sports amenities, as well as a wide range of student societies and activities.
The Faculty of Education is located on the main campus, fostering close interaction between students and faculty.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: With a first-year intake of only 12, JS4361 is a highly selective programme.
In 2025, the programme received 113 Band A applications and made 14 offers, resulting in a Band A offer rate of approximately 12.4%.
The median admission score (Best 5) was 53.75, with a lower quartile of 53 and an upper quartile of 57.5, indicating strong competition.
Applicants should aim for excellent results in Mathematics and M1/M2, as these subjects are weighted double.
The programme also requires an interview, which is an important factor in the selection process.

alumni.title: Alumni and Faculty Excellence
content: The programme is offered by the Faculty of Education, which is consistently ranked among the top education faculties in Asia.
Faculty members have received multiple Teaching Excellence Awards and are active in research on mathematics education, curriculum development, and pedagogical innovation.
Graduates of the programme are highly sought after in Hong Kong secondary schools, with many becoming heads of mathematics departments or curriculum leaders.

scholarships.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of scholarships based on academic merit for both local and non-local students. These scholarships cover tuition fees and living expenses in some cases, making it easier for students to pursue their education at this world-class university.

For local JUPAS students, there are admission scholarships for outstanding achievers. Other major scholarships include the Hong Kong Scholarship for Excellence Scheme and various faculty-specific awards.
Financial aid schemes are also available for students in need. For more information, visit: https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/

tips.title: Ace Sir's JUPAS Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target the Median Score**
Aim for a Best 5 score of at least 53.75 (median). With a lower quartile of 53, you need strong performance in weighted subjects.
- Focus on Mathematics and M1/M2 (each weighted x2).
- Secure at least Level 5** in Mathematics and Level 5* in M1/M2.
**2. Excel in Weighted Electives**
Physics, Economics, or ICT are weighted x1.5. Choose one and aim for Level 5 or above.
- This can significantly boost your total score.
**3. Master the Core Subjects**
Chinese and English are weighted x1.5 (the better of the two). Achieve at least Level 4 in Chinese and Level 3 in English.
- A higher English grade can compensate for a lower Chinese grade.
**4. Prepare Thoroughly for the Interview**
The interview is a key selection criterion. Demonstrate your passion for teaching mathematics and your understanding of educational issues.
- Practice explaining mathematical concepts clearly.
- Be ready to discuss why you want to become a mathematics teacher.
**5. Build a Strong Academic Profile**
Take additional mathematics-related courses or competitions to showcase your interest and ability.
- Participation in the Hong Kong Mathematics Olympiad or similar can strengthen your application.
**6. Understand the Programme Structure**
Familiarize yourself with the double-major curriculum and the teaching practice component. Show that you are committed to both mathematics and education.
- Mention specific courses or teaching experiences that align with the programme.
**7. Gain Relevant Experience**
Volunteer or work in educational settings, such as tutoring or teaching assistant roles. This demonstrates your practical interest in teaching.
- Reflect on these experiences in your personal statement and interview.
**8. Write a Compelling Personal Statement**
Highlight your motivation for teaching mathematics, your academic strengths, and any relevant experiences. Be specific and sincere.
- Connect your personal story to the programme’s mission of nurturing professional mathematics teachers.
**9. Apply Early and Strategically**
Place JS4361 in Band A to maximize your chance of being considered. Ensure all required documents are submitted on time.
- Check the JUPAS website for any updates on application deadlines and requirements.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 本雙主修課程由教育學院與數學系合辦，旨在培養專業數學教師，提供廣泛的學科知識和紮實的教學技能。
學生學習堅實的數學知識，並接受理論與實踐相結合的綜合教師培訓。課程設計富有挑戰性，跨學科性質使學生同時掌握學科內容和教學知識與技能，提升他們對數學和教育的興趣與熱情。
BMED課程還提供提升學科特定技能的科目，例如幾何、統計和微積分的教學與學習；STEM教育中的任務設計；以及數學教育的當代議題。這些課程使學生能夠反思21世紀教與學數學的意義。
通過講座、體驗式學習和中學教學實習，學生獲得數學和教師專業知識，發展研究和實踐的可轉移技能，並具備在數學教學中擔任領導角色的能力。
畢業生將獲頒教育學士學位，主修數學及數學教育，相當於完成學位教師教育文憑課程，並符合資格在中學任教。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 大部分BMED畢業生投身教學專業。隨著經驗積累，部分畢業生在中學數學教學中擔任領導角色。
憑藉課程培養的堅實知識和技能，部分畢業生從事廣泛的職業，如學術研究、科學與科技、金融與銀行、公務員及出版等。
課程亦為有志於數學、數學教育或相關領域深造之畢業生奠定堅實基礎。
除了知識和技能，課程重視培養學生的態度和專業精神。更多BMED學生的觀點可在YouTube上觀看。

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學沙田校園提供充滿活力且支援性強的學習環境，設有九所書院，各提供獨特的住宿、關顧及文化體驗。
學生可使用先進設施、圖書館及體育設施，並參與多元化的學生社團及活動。
教育學院位於主校園，促進師生緊密互動。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力
content: JS4361首年學額僅12個，屬高度競爭課程。
2025年，課程收到113份Band A申請，發出14個錄取，Band A錄取率約12.4%。
中位數入學分數（最佳5科）為53.75，下四分位數53，上四分位數57.5，反映競爭激烈。
申請人應在數學及M1/M2取得優異成績，因這些科目比重加倍。
課程亦設有面試，是甄選過程中的重要因素。

alumni.title: 校友及學院卓越成就
content: 本課程由教育學院開辦，該學院在亞洲教育學院中持續名列前茅。
學院教師屢獲教學卓越獎項，並積極從事數學教育、課程發展及教學創新研究。
課程畢業生深受香港中學歡迎，不少成為數學科主任或課程領導。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地及非本地學生提供多項基於學術成績的獎學金，部分涵蓋學費及生活費，讓學生更容易在這所世界級大學追求學業。
本地JUPAS學生可申請入學獎學金，表揚傑出成就。其他主要獎學金包括香港卓越獎學金計劃及各學院特定獎項。
有需要學生亦可申請資助計劃。詳情請瀏覽：https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/

tips.title: Ace Sir的JUPAS策略 — 9個實用貼士
content: **1. 以中位數為目標**
最佳5科目標分數至少53.75（中位數）。下四分位數為53，需在比重較高科目表現出色。
- 專注數學及M1/M2（各比重x2）。
- 數學至少達5**級，M1/M2至少達5*級。
**2. 在比重選修科表現卓越**
物理、經濟或資訊及通訊科技比重x1.5，選定一科並爭取第5級或以上。
- 這可大幅提升總分。
**3. 掌握核心科目**
中文及英文比重x1.5（取較佳者）。中文至少第4級，英文至少第3級。
- 較高的英文成績可彌補中文的不足。
**4. 充分準備面試**
面試是關鍵甄選標準。展現你對數學教學的熱誠及對教育議題的理解。
- 練習清晰解釋數學概念。
- 準備討論為何想成為數學教師。
**5. 建立強勁學術背景**
參加額外數學相關課程或比賽，展示你的興趣和能力。
- 參與香港數學奧林匹克等活動可加強申請。
**6. 了解課程結構**
熟悉雙主修課程及教學實習部分。展示你對數學及教育兩方面的承擔。
- 提及與課程相關的特定科目或教學經驗。
**7. 獲取相關經驗**
在教育環境中擔任義工或工作，如補習或教學助理。這展示你對教學的實際興趣。
- 在個人陳述及面試中反思這些經驗。
**8. 撰寫具說服力的個人陳述**
突出你對數學教學的動機、學術優勢及相關經驗。要具體且真誠。
- 將你的個人故事與課程培育專業數學教師的使命聯繫起來。
**9. 及早及策略性申請**
將JS4361放在Band A以增加被考慮的機會。確保所有所需文件按時提交。
- 查閱JUPAS網站了解申請截止日期及要求的最新資訊。
